# Termihomo v0.4.11

### 修复
- 统一开机启动、自动运行与手动启动的网络偏好恢复，保持系统代理、TUN 和局域网代理的开关状态。
- 保存局域网代理偏好，修复暂停恢复、内核重启及配置热重载后局域网代理关闭的问题。
- 桌面登录后补做网络偏好恢复，不依赖托盘是否开启；更新已接管系统代理的端口。
- 单项恢复失败时继续尝试其他网络设置，并保留已保存的偏好。
- 补充启动组合、暂停恢复、子进程冷启动与重启、登录恢复及错误处理的回归测试和中英文配置说明。

### Fixes
- Restore saved system proxy, TUN, and LAN proxy preferences consistently on boot, auto-run, and manual startup.
- Persist LAN proxy preferences and retain LAN access across pause/resume, core restarts, and configuration reloads.
- Retry network preference restoration at desktop login independently of tray visibility, and refresh the port of owned system proxy settings.
- Attempt other network settings when an individual restoration fails, without clearing saved preferences.
- Add regression coverage for startup combinations, pause/resume, child-process cold starts and restarts, desktop login restoration, and error handling, with English and Chinese configuration documentation.
